sources.entry: RegexMate - A regular expression testing tool with a built-in quick reference guide.

summary.name: RegexMate
summary.one_liner: RegexMate is a free regular expression editor and tester app from developer 楚江 王, with live matching and a built-in Chinese/English syntax reference.
use_cases: testing a regular expression against sample text
looking up regex syntax without leaving the app
saving frequently used patterns for reuse
summary.what_it_does: RegexMate lets you enter a regular expression and see matches update in real time as you type and tweak the pattern. It includes a reference guide with Chinese and English examples for regex syntax. An expression library lets you save frequently used patterns for quick access. The interface is minimalist and offers light and dark modes. The App Store listing shows it is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision, and the developer lists 'Developer Tools' as its category.
notable: Live preview of matches as you type
Built-in regex reference guide with Chinese and English examples
Listed in awesome-mac under Regular Expression Editors
caveats: Offers in-app purchases (sponsor tiers at $1.99 and $7.99 are listed)
Requires iOS 17.0 or later, iPadOS 17.0 or later, or macOS 14.0 or later
